messages:
Marta D: Hey team, filing a quick docs PR for retention examples + redaction link fixes. Need legal signoff on wording and a tiny migration example for customers using old config keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1289
Alex R: Nice. Can you avoid absolute promises like 'fully unrecoverable'? For SOC2 we should be careful about backups.
sarah.legal: Correct. Recommend phrasing: 'Records are retained for the configured retention period and securely disposed in accordance with the Data Disposal Policy.' Also add a note: 'Customers are responsible for any copies they export or store in third-party systems.' Link to policy: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/data-disposal
Marta D: Updated copy to that wording. I also added a small subsection titled "Export & Redaction" with a link to the redaction guide.
DevEx Bot: PR opened: redwood-inference/docs#1289 by @Marta D  reviewers: @Priya S, @Jordan M
Jordan M: Quick API consistency check: our Node SDK uses `days_ttl` currently, Python uses `ttl_days`. We should pick one. Prefer `ttl_days`.
Priya S: Agreed, `ttl_days` is clearer. If we standardize, I'll update the snippets generator.
Alex R: For migration snippet, propose this jq transform to map old key `audit_log_retention` -> `retention.ttl_days`:
```bash
# migrate old audit_log_retention to new nested retention.ttl_days (default 90)
jq '.retention.ttl_days = (.audit_log_retention // 90)' config-old.json > config-new.json
```
Marta D: Thanks — added that to the PR. Also added curl + node examples:
```bash
# curl example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retention -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"resource":"audit_logs","ttl_days":90}'
```
```js
// Node snippet
const Redwood = require('redwood');
const client = new Redwood.Client();
await client.setRetention('audit_logs', { ttl_days: 90 });
```
Priya S: Small accessibility ask: include a one-line caption above code blocks describing what they do for screen readers. I'll add aria-labels in the snippet renderer.
sarah.legal: One more micro-edit: replace any instance of 'we delete immediately' with 'records are securely disposed per the Data Disposal Policy' and add the policy link. Also ensure we don't imply we can purge customer-managed exports.
Marta D: Done. I added the exact legal phrasing and a clarification callout about customer exports.
Jordan M: CI will catch parameter names mismatch. Can we gate merge until SDK releases are cut?
Marta D: Yep — I added a note: DO NOT MERGE until SDK bump is published.
DevEx Bot: CI status: running (lint, build, snippet-render).
DevEx Bot: CI passed for PR #1289  checks: lint, build (warnings), snippet-render tests
Marta D: CI green; holding merge until @Alex R publishes SDK patch aligning on `ttl_days`.
Alex R: Patch published: node-sdk 2.4.1 -> 2.4.2 (parameter renamed to ttl_days). Ping me when merged and I'll cut a release note.
Priya S: Docs snippet tests passed locally for the new examples. Accessibility labels added.
Marta D: Great — legal signoff included, snippets updated, migration example added. I'll merge once Alex confirms release note posted.
Alex R: Release note posted. You can merge.
Marta D: Merged and pushed to main. Closing the loop: release notes mention parameter standardization (`ttl_days`) and SOC2-friendly disposal wording. Thanks all :tada:
